title: Correct range-maximizing angle
description: Essential: The answer for part (a) must be θ = π/4 (or 45°).

title: Correct area-maximizing angle
description: Essential: The answer for part (b) must be θ = π/3 (or 60°).

title: Correct height-adjusted angle
description: Essential: The answer for part (c) must be θ = arcsin(v₀/√[2(v₀² + gh)]) or an equivalent form.

title: Correct flight time with friction
description: Essential: The answer for part (d) must be T = (2v₀ sin θ / g) / (1 + βv₀ sin θ / g) or an equivalent simplified form.

title: Derivation for range maximization
description: Important: For part (a), the solution should apply calculus (dL/dθ=0) to the range formula L = (v₀²/g) sin(2θ).

title: Derivation for area maximization
description: Important: For part (b), the solution should relate area to a function like cosθ sin³θ and find its maximum via derivative.

title: Setup for height-adjusted problem
description: Important: For part (c), the solution must correctly set up the quadratic equation for time of flight from height -h.

title: Small-β approximation use
description: Important: For part (d), the solution must correctly apply the Taylor expansion e^{-βT} ≈ 1 - βT + (βT)²/2.

title: Sign error in vertical motion
description: Pitfall: Incorrect sign for gravitational acceleration in the equations of motion (e.g., using +g instead of -g).

title: Unit or dimension inconsistency
description: Pitfall: Final answer has inconsistent units or is missing units where required.
